question.prompt: Given that \(x=2\), \(y=1\) is a solution of the system \(\begin{cases}ax+y=5\\x-by=1\end{cases}\), find \(a\) and \(b\) (separate them with a comma).

solutions.explanation: Substitute into the first equation: \(2a+1=5\), so \(a=2\). Substitute into the second equation: \(2-b=1\), so \(b=1\).
solutions.title: Use the given solution
